skill_name: Compare and contrast a data scientist and a software engineer
workflow: Data scientists and software engineers are both key players in the tech industry, using their skills to build and maintain a variety of products and systems. However, their roles and responsibilities differ significantly. Data scientists specialize in analyzing data, gathering insights, and creating models and algorithms that can be used to understand large amounts of data.
